contract: Open the first audio stream from preloaded FLAC bytes, decode all frames through EOF, and release the reader and decoder.

Fold each frame's sample rate, channel count and sample count as three little-endian u32 words. Follow with every interleaved little-endian f32 sample in channel order and finish with the four-byte EOF record.
The pinned reference reads native FLAC decoder frames through the public library API. Both workers keep format changes and convert the native frame samples to f32 without resampling or mixing.
